author: Messimy, Adolphe
title: Mes souvenirs
notes: The memoirs of the French war minister who tried twice to get the army out of the red trousers — in 1911–12 and again in June 1914 — and the origin, in most English accounts, of Eugène Étienne's answer to him: 'Le pantalon rouge, c'est la France!' A memoir written twenty-three years after the events by a man defending his own record, and the famous sentence reaches most readers through Tuchman quoting him rather than through a stenographic record: cite it as what Messimy remembered being said, never as a transcript.
